notes.title: patch notes 0.6.0
notes.content:
here goes a new patch with some important fixes and stuffs!

-repel item was removed from the game
-minor bugs fixed.

notes.content:

-monsters' range decreased for a better gameplay experience
-balancing, durg bear +10% speed
-balancing, some first world enemies nerfed
-new interactive NPCs
-enemy bio stephen's position fixed
-balancing, big wise rat -35% magicial attack
-footsteps sound added
